name: Opus
description: Opus 5.5 High (v7): a planner, not a rule list. Plays as a team: one player on the ball, the rest in open support spots or goal-side cover; it simulates every pass and shot before kicking. Elo 1654 (10th of 98) in the old 5v5 ladder of 2026-11-26 (team ratings, before players existed); scored 1.32 and conceded 0.57 per match against the average team.
